title: Moths in That Box
lines: Ben has moths in a box.
This box has a red lid.
The moths run off to a shed.
The moths sit on a rock.
Ben gets both of them back.

questions.listenFor: Moths. It is stated in the first line - have them reread it rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Where does Ben find the moths?
questions.listenFor: On a rock by the shed. If they say only "the shed," ask them what the moths were sitting on.

questions.ask: Do you think Ben should let the moths go? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is correct. You are listening for a reason from the story, not just yes or no.
